papers.title_en: ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer
papers.authors: Abteen Arab, Guile Wu, Dongfeng Bai
papers.evidence: 改进前馈式视觉几何Transformer以扩展多视图三维重建
papers.tldr: 现有视觉几何变换器通常针对标准分辨率训练，输入升至高清后重建质量容易下降，帧内及编码器注意力也带来高昂计算成本。ReDT将每个视图压缩为固定数量的基准令牌，在紧凑空间中计算跨视图对应关系，再还原至原分辨率生成稠密结果。多数据集实验覆盖标准清晰度至全高清，显示其重建质量和计算效率均优于现有方法。在ETH3D 2K上，ReDT相较VGGT-Ω提速16倍、峰值显存减少34%、倒角距离降低33%，展示了扩展至高清重建的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}

papers.title_en: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
papers.authors: Hyebin Kim, Hwasik Jeong, Joonhyuk Park, Gyeongjin Kang, Jungwoo Kim, Younghyun Kim, Eunbyung Park
papers.evidence: 前馈式多视图三维高斯重建及几何感知局部分组
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯泼溅虽能快速重建并合成新视角，但细粒度几何与外观仍难恢复，提升细节常受全局多视图注意力开销和单次预测能力限制。FineSplat以细粒度图像块为基础，结合邻近视图分组与三维空间分组，并用渲染重建误差反馈细化结果，同时紧凑生成高斯基元。实验显示，该方法在相同或更少的高斯预算下显著领先现有方法。它为兼顾细节质量、推理效率与表示紧凑性提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.

papers.title_en: MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
papers.authors: Yifei Wang, Wei Tian, Wenhua Bao, Jia Zhou, Hanshi Wang, Fudong Ge, Jianhua Wu, Shuai Yuan, Zhipeng Zhang, Xingliang Liu, Xianming Zeng, Jianyun Xu, Bingzhao Gao
papers.evidence: 针对稀疏多视图驾驶场景的前馈三维重建
papers.tldr: 稀疏多视角驾驶图像的曝光、成像处理和光照差异会造成跨相机外观不一致，可能被错误吸收到高斯几何中；深度边界附近的法线约束也容易带来不可靠监督。MCSplat以深度引导的多相机对应构建规范外观空间，并用多尺度双边网格变换器恢复相机原始外观，使光度监督不再污染几何学习；同时依据光度敏感性估计不确定性，自适应调整表面自监督权重。实验表明，该方法提升了重建质量和跨数据集泛化，增强跨视角深度一致性与局部法线吻合度，并减少几何伪影。它为驾驶场景前馈高斯泼溅提供了兼顾外观差异与几何可靠性的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Driving-scene reconstruction via feed-forward Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images remains challenging due to two factors. First, cross-camera photometric inconsistency, caused by variations in exposure, ISP, and illumination, can be incorrectly absorbed into Gaussian geometry. Second, unreliable local geometric supervision arises from normal-based constraints near depth discontinuities. To address these issues, we present \textbf{MCSplat}, a multi-view consistent feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for driving scenes. MCSplat constructs a canonical appearance space from depth-guided multi-camera correspondences to decouple geometry learning from camera-specific appearance. A multi-scale Bilateral Grid Transformer restores raw camera appearance from canonical renderings, enabling photometric supervision without contaminating Gaussian geometry. To improve local geometric reliability, we estimate Fisher-information-based uncertainty from photometric sensitivity and use it to adaptively weight surface-oriented self-supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and generalization across driving datasets. Geometry-oriented evaluations further reveal enhanced cross-view depth consistency and local surface-normal agreement, while qualitative results show fewer geometric artifacts and more coherent structures across overlapping views.

papers.title_en: T(R,O) Grasp++: Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping in Cluttered Environments at Scale
papers.authors: Xin Fei, Zhixuan Xu, Huaicong Fang, Fangjun Chen, Zhaoyu Mu, Rui Yang, Zhexi Luo, Lin Shao
papers.evidence: 跨机器人本体生成杂乱环境中的灵巧抓取动作
papers.tldr: 杂乱场景中的灵巧抓取需要协调高维手部动作，并应对物体与周边环境的复杂约束，跨手型泛化和推理效率均具挑战。研究构建大规模仿真基准，包含8种灵巧手、约5万件物体及约5亿条抓取标注。基于此提出 T(R,O) Grasp++，用扩散式框架合成适配不同手型的抓取姿态。实验中模型平均成功率达88%，推理延迟仅0.3秒，采样效率提高逾10倍，为规模化跨具身抓取提供数据与方法支持。
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous grasping in cluttered scenes remains a central challenge in robotic manipulation, as it requires high-dimensional hand coordination under complex object-environment constraints. To address this problem, we introduce one of the largest simulation benchmarks to date, comprising around 0.5B grasp annotations across eight dexterous hands and approximately 50K objects. Furthermore, we propose T(R,O) Grasp++, a scalable diffusion-based framework for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp synthesis in cluttered environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average success rate of 88% across eight dexterous embodiments. Meanwhile, our pipeline achieves only 0.3s inference latency while improving inference sample efficiency by over 10 times.

papers.title_en: Noise-Invariant Spatial Encoding for 3D Manipulation Policies under Depth Corruption
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Yang, Jiaju He, Ruiteng Zhao, Anqi Cheng, Haiyue Zhu, Kezhi Mao
papers.evidence: 研究具身机器人操作，并处理RGB-D深度噪声导致的感知退化
papers.tldr: 三维操作策略利用显式场景几何推断距离、物体关系和可达性，但普通RGB-D传感器在透明、反光、细薄或无纹理物体附近常产生缺失值与错误表面，导致策略出现明显的深度噪声性能断崖，即使使用匹配噪声训练仍有差距。NISE通过多视角深度校准开展几何交叉视角自监督，并以高斯边缘化三维注意力将位置不确定性融入策略。模拟基准和真实机器人任务显示，该方法提升深度噪声鲁棒性，同时保持干净深度表现。研究推动三维策略从干净深度基准走向普通RGB-D部署。
papers.abstract_en: 3D manipulation policies derive actions from explicit scene geometry rather than color images alone, enabling them to reason over metric distances, object relations, and robot-scene reachability. This geometric interface is also a vulnerability: commodity RGB-D sensors return missing measurements, boundary artifacts, and plausible but wrong surfaces around transparent, reflective, thin, or textureless objects. We study this failure under realistic depth corruption and observe a sharp depth-noise cliff across modern 3D policies, even when they are trained with matched noisy depth. This residual gap motivates a spatial-encoding approach: corrupted depth becomes entangled with the token coordinates and geometry features consumed by the action expert. We propose Noise-Invariant Spatial Encoding (NISE), a 3D policy architecture that learns trustworthy geometry features even facing imperfect depth. NISE uses Geometric Cross-View Self-Supervision to shape shared policy features with calibrated multi-view depth, and Gaussian Marginalized 3D Attention to carry position uncertainty into deployed attention rather than treating every lifted token as exact. Across simulated benchmarks with sensor-realistic corruption and real-robot tasks involving transparent and reflective materials, NISE improves depth-noise robustness while preserving clean-depth performance, supporting 3D policies designed for commodity RGB-D deployment rather than clean-depth benchmarks alone.

papers.title_en: Look Before You Act: Bridging Active Perception and Vision-Language-Action Models via Observation-Aligned Data Adaptation
papers.authors: Jiawei Geng, Zhenyang Liu, Yuzheng Wu, Yongchong Gu, Yanwei Fu
papers.evidence: 联合主动视觉观察与机器人操作策略训练
papers.tldr: 杂乱环境中的机器人不仅要决定如何操作，还要主动寻找观察目标的视角；但相机移动可能令操作策略进入与训练数据不同的初始状态，直接接续操作会使成功率从 46.3% 降至 11.5%。论文提出 ActiveAlign，利用视角轨迹终点与已有示范闭环对齐，筛选成功的后续操作数据来微调 VLA。该方法在 40 项 LIBERO 任务上使 pi_0 和 pi_0.5 分别达到 70.7% 和 72.7% 成功率，真实遮挡任务提升至 83/90。结果表明，让策略训练适配主动观察所诱导的状态分布，能有效弥合感知与操作之间的差距。
papers.abstract_en: Robots manipulating objects in clutter must decide not only how to act, but also where to look. Although active camera motion can expose an occluded target, it may move the robot into an initial observation-state distribution that differs from the manipulation policy's training distribution. We identify this problem as first-frame distribution sensitivity: under perturbed starts in LIBERO, naively prepending camera repositioning to pi_0.5 reduces success from 46.3% to 11.5%. We introduce ActiveAlign, a data-adaptation framework that trains a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy from the states at which active perception terminates. A learned viewpoint module first generates a camera trajectory. Offline, ActiveAlign uses closed-loop alignment to connect the trajectory endpoint to an existing demonstration, replays the remaining manipulation trajectory, and retains successful continuations for fine-tuning. At deployment, the same viewpoint module precedes the adapted VLA without modifying its architecture. Across 40 LIBERO tasks, ActiveAlign achieves 70.7% success with pi_0 and 72.7% with pi_0.5, outperforming their standard-training baselines by 40.0% and 26.4% respectively. Matched-state and data-matched controls support gains beyond prefix shortening and generic viewpoint augmentation; OpenVLA and GR00T N1 also show the same trend. Success rate under physical occlusion in real world increases from 35/90 to 83/90. These results show that active perception benefits manipulation when policy training is aligned with the observation and robot-state distribution induced by viewpoint selection.

papers.title_en: FLoTS-SLAM: Optical Flow-Derived Uncertainty for Monocular Dynamic SLAM with Two-Stage Optimization
papers.authors: Haorui Du, Lipu Zhou
papers.evidence: 单目动态SLAM联合相机位姿估计与三维重建
papers.tldr: 单目动态场景中，运动物体会污染相机位姿估计与三维重建；依赖渲染残差或多视角特征不一致的动态检测缺少直接运动证据，误差也可能传入束调整。FLoTS-SLAM利用光流与相机运动诱导光流的残差估计像素级运动不确定性，并先用高置信像素估计位姿，再联合优化位姿和深度。该方法在DAVIS上的动态掩码平均IoU较先进基线提升35%，在Bonn和TUM上的平均ATE分别降低59%和19%。结果表明，显式运动证据与两阶段优化可提升动态场景单目SLAM的鲁棒性，兼顾动态区域识别与重建。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) remains challenging in dynamic environments. Real-time dynamic object identification in such environments is a critical problem. Recent approaches estimate per-pixel uncertainty from rendering residuals or multiview feature inconsistency to identify dynamic regions. These methods lack direct motion evidence, and their accuracy may degrade when reconstruction is inaccurate or features are ambiguous. In addition, such uncertainty merely downweights pixels in bundle adjustment (BA), so inaccurate uncertainty estimates can still impair camera pose estimation and 3D reconstruction. Accordingly, we present a monocular RGB SLAM system for dynamic scenes. Specifically, a motion uncertainty estimation method is proposed to derive uncertainty from the residual between optical flow and camera motion induced flow, directly reflecting object motion. The estimation varies with frame alignment accuracy, reducing false detections and yielding accurate pixel-level masks of dynamic regions. To make BA more robust, we estimate camera poses from high confidence pixels. These poses are then used to reproject dynamic pixels during joint refinement of poses and depth, reducing the influence of object motion on both pose and depth updates. Moreover, we provide a quantitative evaluation of dynamic masks and analyze how these masks affect the downstream tracking and reconstruction of dynamic objects. Our approach improves the mean dynamic mask IoU by 35\% over a state-of-the-art baseline on DAVIS, and reduces the average ATE by 59\% on Bonn and 19\% on TUM relative to the SLAM backbone used in our system. The source code will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: GazeAct: A Human-Gaze-Annotated Manipulation Dataset for Attention-Regularized Policies
papers.authors: Anupam Pani, Wang Yuan, Qifan Wang, Yanchao Yang
papers.evidence: 用人类注视信号强化多视角机器人操作策略的物体与接触点定位
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作策略需要根据指令准确定位物体、接触点和目标位置，但现有机器人数据集很少把真实人类注视与多相机观测配对。GazeAct采集1.2万条演示，覆盖40项任务和5个领域，并以300赫兹同步记录注视、图像、本体感知与动作。研究将注视目标迁移到其余相机视角，以软监督正则化策略的视觉注意力，推理时不需要注视输入。真实任务平均成功率从48.1%升至58.6%，最高提升25个百分点；在LIBERO-Spatial上也有提升，说明人类注视能有效增强策略视觉落地能力。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies must ground language instructions in the right objects, contact points, and target locations for reliable manipulation. Human gaze provides a natural signal for this grounding, but existing robot datasets rarely pair real human gaze with the multi-camera observations used by modern policies. We introduce GazeAct, a gaze-equipped real-robot manipulation dataset and training framework for multi-view VLA policies. Using screen-based teleoperation, we record gaze directly on the robot camera feed viewed by the operator, yielding 12000 demonstrations across 40 tasks and five domains with 300 Hz gaze synchronized with images, proprioception, and actions. We transfer gaze from the operator-selected view to the remaining synchronized cameras, producing spatially consistent targets across the policy's visual inputs. We then use these gaze-derived targets to regularize language-conditioned visual attention during training while keeping inference gaze-free. Across 18 real-world tasks, our method improves average success from 48.1% to 58.6%, with gains up to 25 percentage points. Ablations show that gaze works best as soft supervision and that real human gaze provides stronger attention targets than generic attention-shaping priors. The gains transfer to LIBERO-Spatial (57.9% to 69.6%) and different VLA backbones.These results show that gaze collected in the robot observation space can provide effective training-time targets for improving visual grounding in VLA manipulation.

papers.title_en: IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation
papers.authors: Jiaxing Chen, Zizheng Yan, Jingyu Zhuang, Jinwei Chen, Shuguang Cui, Guanying Chen, Qingnan Fan
papers.evidence: 用相机内参几何一致性改进三维度量几何估计
papers.tldr: 从图像恢复度量三维几何受透视投影歧义影响，现有测试时适配多依赖外部深度数据。IntriAdapt 将已知相机内参作为输出侧几何验证信号，以点云视线与相机射线的闭式残差校准冻结基础模型上的轻量级 LoRA 适配器。序列适配后，模型可直接前馈处理同一相机拍摄的未见图像，无需逐帧重复优化。在十个单图和七个序列基准、多种基础模型上，该方法稳定优于未适配及预言式内参基线，为无需深度传感器的几何校准提供了通用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

papers.title_en: Drive2Gauss: FeedForward 4D Gaussian Reconstruction from Multimodal Generative Driving Videos
papers.authors: Tong Zhao, Zhiyuan Han, Lin Chen, Bowen Xie, Yunxi Qiao, Bohan Li, Weiqing Xiao, Gen Li, Shu Han, Xuyang Dai, Cheng Bi, Hao Zhao, Chaojian Li
papers.evidence: 前馈地将多模态视频转换为动态四维高斯场景
papers.tldr: 驾驶环境生成不仅要呈现可控的未来观测，还需恢复能从不同视角渲染的显式动态场景；既有方法通常要针对每段生成视频单独优化，效率受限。Drive2Gauss先根据参考多视角图像和未来控制信号，联合预测图像、米制深度与动态光流，再以深度初始化稀疏三维查询、用光流建立时序关联，并通过时空特征聚合和迭代细化生成四维高斯场景。整个重建过程只需一次前馈推理，无需逐场景优化。在nuScenes上，未来图像生成FID为6.38、FVD为12.43，重建生成观测的PSNR达29.91 dB。该方法将可控视频生成与可重用场景表示相连，也支持横向移相机渲染及下游视频修复。
papers.abstract_en: Generating reusable driving environments requires both controllable future observations and an explicit representation that supports rendering from different viewpoints, yet existing methods still recover explicit scenes from generated RGB videos through optimization for each sequence. To overcome these limitations, we present Drive2Gauss, a feedforward framework that converts jointly generated RGB, metric depth, and dynamic flow into dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes. A Multimodal Video Generator predicts the three modalities from reference multiview images and future control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Gaussian Query Decoder that uses depth to initialize sparse 3D queries and flow to associate the queries across time, and integrates appearance information through spatiotemporal feature aggregation and iterative query refinement. The reconstruction stage operates in a single feedforward pass without optimization for each scene. Extensive results on nuScenes demonstrate that our approach attains an FID of 6.38 and an FVD of 12.43 for future RGB generation, a PSNR of 29.91 dB when reconstructing its generated observations, and supports both direct rendering under lateral camera shifts and downstream video fixing. Code and more visualizations are available at https://zttt04. github.io/Drive2Gauss_page/.

papers.title_en: X-Splat: Unified Gaussian Splatting for Joint RGB and X-ray 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Wangze Xu, Chu Zhou, Mae Yamaguchi, Linrui Dai, I-Chao Shen, Takashi Ijiri, Imari Sato
papers.evidence: 直接研究多模态三维表面与几何重建
papers.tldr: RGB图像呈现物体外观，X射线揭示内部结构，联合重建有助于更完整地理解真实物体；但以往方法为两种模态分别优化模型，容易产生冗余几何、对齐伪影与松散耦合。X-Splat让所有高斯基元共享几何参数，仅为靠近表面的基元添加外观属性，并借助多视图立体结果和X射线几何代理完成配准。随后通过两种模态的监督联合优化，并引入源自X射线几何的表面深度一致性损失引导RGB重建。在两个数据集上的实验表明，该方法改善对齐与RGB渲染质量，同时不牺牲X射线重建效果，且表示更紧凑，为跨模态联合建模提供统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Jointly reconstructing RGB and X-ray provides new insights by connecting external appearance with internal structure, enabling a more complete understanding of real-world objects than single modality. Yet existing methods train separate models per modality and suffer from redundant geometry, alignment artifacts, and loose coupling that limits cross-modal insight discovery. We propose a unified representation in which all Gaussian primitives share a single set of geometric parameters, with only surface-proximal primitives additionally carrying appearance attributes. We perform cross-modal registration through clean multi-view stereo and X-ray geometric proxies instead of aligning two sets of optimized Gaussians, improving alignment stability. We then jointly optimize the unified representation via supervision from both modalities, complemented by a surface-depth consistency loss derived from X-ray geometry to guide RGB reconstruction. Experiments on the InsideOut dataset and our Flower & Insect dataset show that our framework achieves more robust cross-modal alignment, higher RGB rendering quality without compromising X-ray reconstruction, and a more compact representation than maintaining two independent geometries.

papers.title_en: SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes
papers.authors: Yizheng Xie, Yalda Foroutan, George Shramko, Daniel Rebain, Shrisudhan Govindarajan, Andrea Tagliasacchi
papers.evidence: 以三维高斯表示分解场景并建模可交互对象的离散状态
papers.tldr: 传统三维高斯泼溅通常假设场景静止，难以表达随手拍摄中开门、拨动开关等离散交互；按时间拟合的动态方法又把观测时刻与物体状态绑定，只能重放已见序列。SwitchSplat将场景拆为共享静态底座与多个对象槽位，每个槽位学习一个可交互物体的两种二值状态，并通过可微高斯分配从视频中自动发现状态几何。用户可在任意视角自由组合槽位状态，合成采集时未出现的配置；新建随手拍摄数据集上的实验显示，其新视角合成优于静态与动态基线。该表示使三维重建从复现视频拓展到可组合的场景状态编辑。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io

papers.title_en: OV-PEAR: Observation-Verified Pose-Scale Estimation and Reconstruction for Unknown Industrial Manipulation Objects
papers.authors: Guoqin Tang, Qingxuan Jia, Yichen Tan, Zihang Lv, Ruiquan Wang, Zeyuan Huang, Gang Chen
papers.evidence: 为未知工业操纵物体估计位姿尺度并重建可操作三维模型
papers.tldr: 精细工业操作需要未知物体的六维位姿、尺度和可供操作的三维模型，但依赖CAD、专用训练数据或稳定工位的方法难以应对新物体，零样本方案还易受遮挡、生成偏差和尺度不确定性影响。OV-PEAR先从RGB-D实例生成三维假设，再通过外观感知视图检索、显式尺度搜索和可见性感知配准锚定机器人坐标系。随后将多视角深度证据投回物体坐标系，验证体素占据、抑制幻觉并构建可信模型。在BOP-Industrial上平均AR为0.657，连接器装配抓取成功率达99.67%、装配成功率达84.00%。该框架兼顾未知物体重建、位姿尺度估计和模型复用，为精细操作提供实用支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. Existing industrial pose estimation relies on CAD models, object-specific training data, or stable workcells, limiting use with unseen objects; zero-shot methods suffer from single-view occlusion, generative bias, and scale uncertainty. We present OV-PEAR, an observation-verified framework for 3D reconstruction and pose-scale estimation of unknown industrial objects. Its three-stage object-centric pipeline: (1) segments RGB-D instances and generates object-level 3D hypotheses; (2) anchors them to the robot frame via appearance-aware view retrieval, explicit scale search, and visibility-sensitive registration; (3) back-projects multi-view RGB-D evidence into the object-canonical frame to verify voxel occupancy, suppress hallucinations, and produce reusable trusted object models. On BOP-Industrial, OV-PEAR achieves 0.657 average AR and improves pose and voxel-level geometric consistency in real scenes; real-robot connector assembly reaches 99.67% grasp and 84.00% assembly success. The model library and pose-scale log enable short-term object-level state maintenance at 0.02 ms/frame.

papers.title_en: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Emirkan Burak Yilmaz, Yakup Genc
papers.evidence: Transformer根据二维三维对应关系回归六维物体位姿
papers.tldr: 经典PnP-RANSAC能利用二维—三维对应关系求解物体位姿，但有额外计算开销；研究希望获得快速、可微且免迭代的替代方案。PnP-Transformer接收半稠密对应场与置信度，将几何输入映射到连续潜空间，并直接回归六自由度位姿；它与对应模块分开训练，并被用于零样本六维位姿估计。该方法在七个核心BOP数据集上取得41.2%的平均AR，推理耗时为每物体0.46秒，优于除Co-op外的既有基线。改用EPnP-RANSAC后平均AR升至52.2%，但每物体多耗时约60毫秒，体现了精度与速度的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer

papers.title_en: ForagerSim: Evaluating Embodied Map-Based Reasoning in Large-Scale Dynamic Worlds
papers.authors: Tomáš Musil, Martin Kotík, Michal Vavrečka, Karla Štěpánová, Sebastian Scherer, Martin Saska
papers.evidence: 评测具身智能体在动态大规模世界中的地图推理与导航
papers.tldr: 动物能构建认知地图，在广阔环境中导航与搜索；但现有具身智能系统依赖脆弱的手工建图，或难以学出地图式表征，而相关评测也不足。论文提出 ForagerSim，以模块化仿真覆盖机器人搜救和动物觅食，并可分别调节感知、尺度、拓扑、动态干扰与任务。对八种示例世界的比较显示，二维感知下的学习策略在简单拓扑中能完成多目标搜索和井点交替，却在更大或更复杂的环境中落后于人类，地图式基线表现较好。平台由此揭示，地图式推理是现有策略应对复杂空间任务的关键瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Animals build cognitive maps of vast environments, use them to perform map-based navigation, and might even be reusing the same circuitry used in spatial reasoning for creating and using maps of arbitrary task-spaces. In contrast, current embodied AI systems either rely on hand-engineered mapping pipelines, which break in the presence of unmodeled dynamics and are restricted to metric space, or on learned policies that rarely form map-like representations at all. Developing architectures that could learn to build and use map-like representations as flexibly as animals is, however, difficult because few embodied AI benchmarks actually require map-based reasoning. To address this, we present ForagerSim --- an interdisciplinary research platform and simulation environment focused on embodied tasks that require map-based reasoning, with scenarios ranging from mobile-robot search and rescue to animal foraging in both complex mazes and vast, potentially infinite open areas. ForagerSim is highly modular and allows modifying independent axes of difficulty related to perception (abstract 2D sensing to full RGB or LiDAR), scale (room-scale to multi-km scale), topology (open-fields to complex mazes), dynamics (smoke, debris, sensorimotor failures and others) and tasks (from simple 2D coverage to foraging-inspired well-alternation tasks). We compare reinforcement learning baselines with a simple engineered robotics stack and a human player on 8 example worlds which show how different difficulty axes affect existing methods. Our results show that, when sensing is simplified to 2D, learned policies can perform multi-object search and well-alternation tasks surprisingly well in simple topologies, but they fall short of human performance in larger or more complex-topology environments where map-based baselines perform well, suggesting that map-based reasoning is the bottleneck in these scenarios.

papers.title_en: ControlFlow3D: Distilling Multi-View Knowledge into Latent Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
papers.authors: Yuang Liu, Zhi Zuo, Zhengkai Zhao, Lirui Zhang, Pan Gao, Hao Feng, Zhengzhe Liu
papers.evidence: 利用多视图知识改善稀疏点云几何补全
papers.tldr: 点云上采样面对稀疏观测时几何约束不足，难以消除形状歧义；多视图图像能够补充信息，但现有多模态方法尚未充分利用。ControlFlow3D在训练阶段将预训练模型的视觉知识蒸馏进轻量生成网络，在冻结三维编码器定义的潜空间中执行条件流匹配，并以共享原型控制生成轨迹、逐步对齐图像与几何特征。测试时无需多视图图像，Mamba解码器即可生成稠密坐标；实验验证其在多个基准上的有效性与泛化能力，并推出规模为3.5万对象、较既有数据集扩大31倍的ShapeNetPU。
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud upsampling is essential for 3D applications but remains challenging due to sparse, under-constrained observations. Multi-view images can resolve geometric ambiguity, but existing multi-modal methods do not fully exploit visual cues. We propose ControlFlow3D, a framework that distills knowledge from pretrained foundation models into a lightweight generation network during training, enabling strong performance without multi-view images available at test time. Specifically, our method performs conditional flow matching in a structured latent space defined by a frozen 3D encoder. Multi-view image tokens and 3D latent tokens are jointly clustered into shared prototypes via unsupervised soft KMeans; the resulting prototypes guide the flow trajectory through velocity control and are aligned by a consistency loss that progressively transfers image knowledge into the base network. A Mamba-based geometry decoder then maps latent features to dense coordinates with linear complexity. We also construct ShapeNetPU, a 35K-object multi-modal benchmark that is 31 times larger than prior datasets. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its strong generalization capability.

papers.title_en: Context Matters! Social, Spatial, and Semantic Coordination with an Embodied Agent in Immersive Analytics
papers.authors: Andrew Cunningham, Nicolas Barbotin, Adam Drogemuller, Jack Faser
papers.evidence: 提出具身人工智能体的情境感知设计框架与交互探针
papers.tldr: 沉浸式分析中的增强现实智能体有望让用户以更自然的方式协作，但其设计必须理解空间、社交关系与任务语义等情境。论文提出由空间、社交、语义三维构成的情境感知设计框架，并区分智能体在情境中的嵌入程度及其感知和响应能力。作者以 Cobot 作为设计探针，结合凝视提示、空间音频和任务感知行为探索框架。设计反思总结了面向未来情境感知具身智能体的启示，为相关交互设计提供初步概念基础。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI agents in Augmented Reality (AR) could enable more natural collaboration in immersive analytics by engaging users through spatial, conversational, and visual interaction. However, designing such agents requires careful attention to context. We propose a preliminary conceptual framework for context-aware design of embodied agents structured around three dimensions of spatial, social, and semantic. This framework is further categorised into embeddedness (how agents are situated in the contexts) and awareness (how agents perceive and respond to the contexts). To explore this, we present Cobot, an embodied AI agent designed as a design probe. Cobot supports context-sensitive interaction through features such as gaze cues, spatial sound, and task-aware behaviour. We reflect on its design and identify implications for future contextaware embodied agents.

papers.title_en: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
papers.authors: Hongchang Liu, Jian Liu, Yujuan Ding, Liang Peng, Xun Jiang, Fei Ma, Xing Xu, Yi Bin
papers.evidence: 多视图几何特征构成可预测的三维场景状态
papers.tldr: 三维世界模型采用几何基础模型（GFM）特征作为预测状态，可利用其几何先验，但视角依赖会将场景动态与相机变化混合，增加预测难度。GeoState聚合多视角特征生成视角解耦的场景状态，由几何解码器按相机射线查询；自回归模型预测状态，相机运动则单独建模。预测状态可在预测或外部指定的相机视角下解码，且整个推演保持上下文确定的统一尺度，无需逐帧对齐。实验显示，该方法在Waymo上优于既有模型，支持几何一致的跨视角查询，并零样本泛化至KITTI和nuScenes，为可控的三维世界建模提供了新表示。
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

papers.title_en: ESC: Escaping 2D Diffusion Ambiguity with Geometric Constraints for Consistent Novel View Synthesis
papers.authors: Ge Ya Luo, Daniel Severo, Brian Karrer, Christopher Pal, Adriana Romero-Soriano, Michal Drozdzal
papers.evidence: 联合生成目标视图和深度图，并约束跨视角深度一致性
papers.tldr: 从单张图像生成视角大幅变化的新视图，是二维扩散模型面临的挑战：缺少三维约束会导致几何错位与跨视图不一致。本文以源图像、源深度和目标相机射线为条件，让模型联合生成目标视图及对应深度图，并加入逐像素深度一致性约束。论文报告该方法在视觉准确度和空间对齐方面优于现有先进方法，且能应对剧烈视角变化。其贡献是以深度约束强化几何对齐，为从单幅图像构建更可靠的三维世界模型提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generating 3D-consistent novel views from 2D diffusion models remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. In this work, we introduce a framework that enhances geometric alignment for monocular view synthesis under drastic camera changes by jointly generating a target view and its corresponding depth map. By conditioning the diffusion pipeline on the single source image, source depth, and target camera rays, our approach forces the model to inherently reason in 3D space even under extreme viewpoint shifts. To guarantee spatial fidelity, we propose a novel per-pixel depth consistency constraint, which verifies and enforces 3D consistency across generated views. Our framework establishes a robust pipeline for geometrically consistent view synthesis, yielding superior visual accuracy and spatial alignment compared to current state-of-the-art methods. With this work, we pave the road towards robust 3D world models capable of understanding complex environments from a single view image.

papers.title_en: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
papers.authors: Yuze He, Bin Tan, Zelin Gao, Yujun Shen, Yong-Jin Liu, Nan Xue, Yinghao Xu
papers.evidence: Transformer视频世界模型持续预测并存储场景平面几何
papers.tldr: 视频世界模型需要在长时生成和大幅视角变化中记住已生成场景，但逐像素点云存储开销大，几何一致性也难保障。PPMem以平面基元构建持久三维记忆，在自回归视频分块中联合预测RGB与平面几何，再将合并记忆渲染为深度，供后续生成使用。其场景记忆约含十万个基元、仅占5MB，较点云紧凑约三个数量级；在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上提升视频质量，同时输出米制深度、法线与可导出平面，并在数百帧及大幅视角变化下维持连贯。研究展示了紧凑、显式且能随生成更新的场景记忆，可支持可扩展的长期视频探索。
papers.abstract_en: Video world models that generate and explore environments at scale need a persistent 3D memory of what they have produced. Plane primitives offer a natural candidate: a compact set of oriented planes captures the dominant structural elements (e.g., walls, floors, facades) of indoor and outdoor scenes, while requiring only 7 parameters per primitive. We present PPMem, a video world model that adopts plane primitives as its persistent 3D memory. PPMem augments a video diffusion transformer with a planar prediction head and a Depth Token Fusion (DTF) module: each autoregressive chunk jointly produces RGB video and planar geometry, which merges into a persistent plane memory that conditions subsequent chunks via rendered depth. The resulting memory is three orders of magnitude more compact than per-pixel point clouds (~100K primitives, 5MB for a full scene), geometrically explicit (metric depth, normals, exportable surfaces), cross-view consistent (jointly predicted by the shared backbone), and adaptive (refined by the merging procedure as generation proceeds). On DL3DV and RealEstate10K, PPMem outperforms prior 3D-grounded world models in video quality while jointly producing metric-scale depth, surface normals, and exportable planar geometry, sustaining coherence across hundreds of frames under large viewpoint changes. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/ppmem.

papers.title_en: Smartphone-Based, Field-Deployed AI Inspection System for Power Distribution Infrastructure
papers.authors: Sampath Balaji Masabathula, Srija Vanapalli, Gangadhar Kanchi, Sreenivasa Rao V. A. N, Vijaya Lalitha, Sasank Chilamkurthy
papers.evidence: 结合单目深度估计和几何分析判断设施状态
papers.tldr: 地理分散的配电网络使人工巡检难以保持一致，也不易规模化开展，缺陷记录和整改跟踪因此面临挑战。研究提出手机端人工智能巡检流程，通过图像质量与视角校验，结合深度学习、单目深度估计、几何分析和规则处理，评估杆塔倾斜、横担倾斜、电压等级、植被间隙及变压器对地距离。在安德拉邦东部配电公司五条馈线上试点，共识别1,222项缺陷，研究期间记录84项完成整改，并公开现场数据集PD-Defect。该系统支持缺陷识别、记录、整改追踪和复核；馈线停电数据不足以证明其改善了供电可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Routine inspection of power distribution infrastructure remains challenging for utilities operating geographically dispersed networks, where conventional manual inspection can be difficult to perform consistently and at scale. This work presents a smartphone-based AI inspection system for assessing targeted distribution-infrastructure conditions from images captured by field personnel. The proposed workflow integrates image-quality and viewing-perspective validation with AI-assisted assessment of pole lean, crossarm and top-cleat tilt, voltage level, vegetation-clearance risk, and distribution-transformer (DTR)-ground clearance. The system integrates deep-learning models with monocular depth estimation, geometric analysis, and rule-based processing within a common multi-stage inspection workflow designed for practical field operation. The system was pilot deployed across five selected distribution feeders within the Eastern Power Distribution Company of Andhra Pradesh Ltd. (APEPDCL), where 1,222 defect instances were identified across the assessed categories and subsequently tracked through a rectification and verification workflow, with 84 defect instances recorded as rectified during the study period. Feeder-level interruption records were also examined over the study period; however, the available observations do not provide sufficient evidence to establish a reliability improvement attributable to the proposed system. A curated multi-module field-captured dataset, PD-Defect, is also publicly released to support reproducible research in distribution-infrastructure inspection. The field deployment demonstrates the practical integration of smartphone-based AI-assisted inspection into field inspection and maintenance activities, providing a mechanism for systematic identification, documentation, rectification tracking, and verification of targeted distribution-infrastructure defects.

papers.title_en: LiFi: LiDAR Generation from Multi-View Images via Geometric and Semantic Collaborative Guidance
papers.authors: Sizhuo Zhou, Xiaosong Jia, Fanrui Zhang, Qifeng Li, Junjie Li, Zirui Wang, Yukang Feng, Yu Hong, Shaofeng Zhang, Wenlong Liao, Tao He, Juyong Zhang, Junchi Yan
papers.evidence: 从多视图图像生成几何对齐的三维激光雷达点云
papers.tldr: 多视角相机图像生成激光雷达点云有助于可控数据合成、跨模态仿真与感知研究，但现有方法多未针对该任务设计，且常忽略几何信息或仅使用单目输入，生成质量和对齐效果受限。LiFi提出面向多视角输入的专用框架，以几何与语义双分支协同引导潜在扩散生成。几何分支结合反向采样、不确定性感知编码器和DepthAnything3，语义分支通过跨视角交互提取高层表示，并用双分支平衡CFG兼顾条件生成与协同控制。实验表明其生成高保真激光雷达场景，优于现有先进方法，为图像驱动的激光雷达场景合成提供新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generating LiDAR point clouds from multi-view camera images is a valuable task with applications in controllable data synthesis, cross-modal simulation and various perception tasks. However, most existing methods are not specifically designed for this task, and the quality of their generated LiDAR remains limited. Moreover, these methods typically focus only on semantic cues in images or generate LiDAR from a monocular camera image. In this work, we introduce LiFi (LiDAR From images), a dedicated framework for generating visually and geometrically aligned LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process through two complementary branches: geometry and semantics. The geometry branch constructs scene features from images through a reverse sampling algorithm and an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder combined with DepthAnything3, whereas the semantic branch provides high-level semantic representations via a cross-view interaction module. We further introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy, which enhances the model's conditional generation capability while preserving the independent learning and collaborative controllability of the two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiFi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi.

papers.title_en: SIEVE: Overcoming Topological Obstruction in Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
papers.authors: Jongann Lee, Sun Woo Park, Yun Young Choi
papers.evidence: 通过SE(3)等变学习提取点云几何不变表征
papers.tldr: 三维点云掩码自编码与SE(3)等变网络存在理论不兼容：常规遮挡会造成拓扑坍塌，使模型在缺乏参考坐标系时被迫臆测朝向。SIEVE提出球面投影掩码，在保留整体位姿的同时遮蔽局部语义，并将几何压缩为不变标量嵌入。实验显示，该设计避免常量掩码和噪声掩码导致的坍塌；下游任务表现优于坐标基线和手工几何描述子，且对未见类别泛化提升最大。工作为等变自监督学习提供了规避拓扑障碍的设计路径。
papers.abstract_en: We identify a theoretical incompatibility between 3D point cloud masked autoencoding and SE(3)-equivariant networks. We prove that standard masking triggers a topological collapse, effectively forcing the model to hallucinate orientation without a reference frame. To resolve this, we introduce SIEVE (Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance), an SE(3)-equivariant self-supervised framework that compresses point cloud geometry into invariant scalar embeddings. At its core is the spherical projection mask, which preserves global pose while obfuscating local semantics, sidestepping the obstruction by construction. Experiments confirm that SIEVE circumvents the predicted collapse where constant and noise masks fail. On downstream point cloud tasks, the resulting embeddings improve over coordinate-based baselines and hand-crafted geometric descriptors, with the largest gains on generalization to unseen shape categories.

papers.title_en: CF-Splat: Closed-Form Triangle Splatting with Mesh Priors
papers.authors: Yixin Fang, Liang Zhao
papers.evidence: 在已知三角网格上进行高效场景外观估计
papers.tldr: 泼溅式辐射场能生成高质量新视角图像，但主流方法依赖迭代非线性优化，处理大量耦合参数时耗时、耗显存，也容易陷入局部最优。CF-Splat面向已有网格和标定相机，将像素颜色表示为网格顶点球谐系数的线性函数，并以全局线性最小二乘估计场景外观。自适应球谐正则化应对视角覆盖不均，矩阵无关预条件共轭梯度求解大规模问题。实验显示其合成质量具有竞争力，较三维高斯泼溅大幅降低计算时间与显存，为网格上的高效外观估计提供了闭式方案。
papers.abstract_en: Splatting-based radiance-field representations have recently gained popularity in robotic perception, enabling high-quality novel-view synthesis (NVS) through explicit scene primitives. However, existing splatting methods typically rely on iterative nonlinear optimization that jointly optimizes millions of coupled primitive parameters, resulting in substantial computation time, peak GPU memory consumption, and susceptibility to local minima. In this paper, we propose CF-Splat, a novel closed-form triangle-splatting framework for efficient scene appearance estimation over a known mesh either pre-existing or provided by upstream mapping or reconstruction pipelines. Our key insight is that, by properly formulating the problem over the given mesh geometry and calibrated cameras, the rendered pixel colors can be expressed linearly with respect to the per-vertex spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients, allowing multi-view scene appearance estimation to be formulated as a global linear least-squares (LLS) problem without the need of iterative nonlinear optimization. To guarantee a well-posed solution under uneven multi-view observation coverage, we introduce adaptive SH regularization that constrains insufficiently supported high-order SH coefficients and yields a unique global minimizer. To ensure the scalability to large-scale scenes, we develop a triangle-structured matrix-free preconditioned conjugate-gradient solver that avoids explicitly constructing the large sparse normal system while producing the same LLS solution. Experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate that CF-Splat achieves competitive or superior NVS quality compared with state-of-the-art splatting methods. While, CF-Splat requires approximately 27.5-378.0 times less computation time and 1.8 times lower peak GPU memory on average than 3DGS across scenes of different scales on a consumer-grade laptop.

papers.title_en: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Han Su, Meng Tian, Tianyu Huang, Mingyu Gao, Lennox Wei, Dongxu Li, Jianhua Han, Hang Xu, Xiaohe Wu, Wangmeng Zuo
papers.evidence: 利用估计三维点与相机位姿改善跨视角空间推理
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型在跨视角理解三维空间关系、并随观察者移动更新判断时仍表现不足；将重建特征融合进视觉令牌，又难与预训练语义表征对齐，空间监督有限时尤为困难。DK-VLM提出双核注意力，分别依据输入位置与场景几何位置计算注意力，并以门控融合；再用参考系组合监督训练逐步更新朝向和坐标参照。DK-VLM-8B在六项空间基准平均成绩领先，在VSI-Bench和ReVSI-32分别得74.33、58.28；组合监督进一步增强多步推理，且保留通用视频理解能力。该方法将几何作为位置注入注意力，为空间推理提供兼顾语义能力与几何线索的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.
